rejectionReasons.source-reference-missing: Require stable source structure/feature/edge IDs, not a new world XYZ exception.
rejectionReasons.existing-slot-required: No new population or independently placed building detail is authorized by this contract.
rejectionReasons.profile-incompatible: Keep existing geometry for an unsupported representative profile.
rejectionReasons.source-part-height-conflict: Keep the complete detail inside its actual source minHeight and wall/eave top interval.
rejectionReasons.invalid-dimensions: Reject missing, nonfinite, zero or negative fit dimensions.
rejectionReasons.source-edge-too-short: The complete module must stay inside the named source edge.
rejectionReasons.width-out-of-range: Do not stretch an opening or exceed the declared linear span range.
rejectionReasons.cross-section-exceeds-slot: Preserve Y/Z section and the already-emitted replacement volume.
rejectionReasons.opening-mismatch: Match the actual clear width and height, not the outer frame dimensions.
rejectionReasons.glass-stop-unavailable: No physical glazing stop exists at this LOD; keep source glazing/fallback.
rejectionReasons.entry-exclusion-overlap: Preserve the existing door/opening exclusion volume.
rejectionReasons.domestic-ground-pane-reserved: The domestic ground pane may be replaced by the existing door shader.
rejectionReasons.corner-frame-required: Require two named adjacent edges and an exterior 90-degree corner.
rejectionReasons.corner-handedness-mismatch: The +X-return authoring frame is not a mirrored -X-return variant.
rejectionReasons.roof-incompatible: Require an exposed flat commercial roof and preserve exclusions.
rejectionReasons.parapet-insert-mismatch: The existing wall section must fit the actual inverted-U cavity.
rejectionReasons.pavement-provenance-required: Require samples from the actual rendered sidewalk/surface triangles.
rejectionReasons.pavement-samples-missing: At least left, center and right finite samples are required.
rejectionReasons.pavement-grade-exceeded: More than 0.14 m range rejects a rigid ground-datum module.
rejectionReasons.elevated-source-part: Ground entry/bay modules cannot be placed on an elevated building part.
rejectionReasons.threshold-below-foundation: Highest pavement +0.02 m cannot be below the existing foundation.
rejectionReasons.upper-window-conflict: Module crown must stay below the explicitly preserved upper window/sill.
rejectionReasons.roof-height-conflict: Module crown must stay below the source wall top minus 0.30 m.
rejectionReasons.entry-clearance-mismatch: Preserve at least the 1.04 by 2.30 m residential clear opening.
rejectionReasons.ground-datum-rebased: Keep the ground-referenced canopy origin; never move its minimum Y to zero.

materialPolicy: Reuse existing semantic surface IDs and shared atlas; embedded inspection images are not new runtime textures.
editableSourcePolicy: Existing editable .blend references retained and SHA-256 verified; this adaptation does not re-export or claim a new Blender source audit.
